lines.text: Day seven. Thirty-one carriages between you and the brake. One torch.
And the last carriage is sealed. From the inside.
lines.cap:
AND THE LAST ONE IS SEALED.
FROM THE INSIDE.

lines.text: The brake resets by hand. At the far end. On foot.
lines.cap:
THE BRAKE RESETS BY HAND.
AT THE FAR END. ON FOOT.

lines.text: Rule one. Torch at the floor. You see legs before faces.
lines.cap:
RULE 1. TORCH AT THE FLOOR.
LEGS BEFORE FACES.

lines.text: So the beam stays low. Carriage one. Empty.
Radio. Recovery in four days. Do not open sealed compartments.
lines.cap:
RADIO: RECOVERY IN 4 DAYS.
DO NOT OPEN SEALED DOORS.

lines.text: Rule two. One hand always empty.
Torch left. Right hand free. Twelve. Twenty. Twenty-six. Empty.
Thirty-one carriages. Thirty-one empty. Every one, this time.
Rule three. Never open a door you can't close behind you.
lines.cap:
RULE 3. NEVER OPEN A DOOR
YOU CAN'T CLOSE AGAIN.

lines.text: The lever is outside thirty-two. You don't need the door.
lines.cap:
THE LEVER IS OUTSIDE 32.
YOU DON'T NEED THE DOOR.

lines.text: Four thirty-one. Hand on the lever. The knocking starts.
lines.cap:
4:31 AM. HAND ON THE LEVER.
THE KNOCKING STARTS.

lines.text: Not banging. Knocking. Three long. Three short. Three long.
You know that pattern. Your mirror. Day four.
The car behind you. You drove on. Their lights went out.
lines.cap:
THE CAR BEHIND YOU.
THEIR LIGHTS WENT OUT.

lines.text: She's walked three days. Following the only other thing alive.
And she sealed the door from inside. Nobody seals a door against nothing.
